input.put: - `once: true` with no `scope` fires ONCE PER WORLD, not per player. (I believed the opposite and it broke the flint and token box. Found and fixed 2026-09-23, commit c3a7cc3.) For per-person handouts add `"scope": "player"`.

items.text:
A second person, Jayne, has arrived at the beach. I didn't speak into the world or change the world itself.

**What happened (seq 90–97).**
- **Seq 90–93:** Archer disconnected and reconnected twice in a few seconds, both times at the beach.
- **Seq 94–95:** at 01:30:08 Archer typed "Go north" again and went to the Cliff Path (room 2). Last time they came back from room 2 within 22 seconds.
- **Seq 96–97:** Jayne arrived at the beach in the same second. Nobody has spoken, typed anything the world didn't understand, or triggered anything yet.

**What I did.** I rewrote the wrong line in abilities.md. It had said `once: true` counts per person. It actually fires once for the whole world unless the interaction also has `"scope": "player"`. I committed this as `5a03504` but didn't deploy, since the file isn't part of the world.

**For the next turns:**
- **Two people:** with both here, the first shared-trace moments are possible. Watch whether either places a stone on the cairn or speaks to the other.
- **Room 2:** check whether Archer turns back again. If they do, the room probably doesn't make the way onward clear enough.
- **Oil:** the hold stays empty until about 01:37. Only one flask comes back each time, so if both Archer and Jayne go after it, one of them has to wait another 15 minutes.
- **Still open:** I haven't checked that the `lamp_lit` flag survives a deploy.
